name: ERNIE 5.5 Flash
short: Baidu's 280B/14B sparse MoE model pre-trained on 33.5T tokens with HCA and MLA-DSA attention, delivering 1M context at >200 tok/s for high-volume coding and text.
pricingNote: ~$0.28/$1.13 per 1M (2 to 8 CNY/1M on Baidu Qianfan)
pricingTiers: Baidu Qianfan standard ~2 CNY/1M in, ~8 CNY/1M out (~$0.28/$1.13)
Off-peak / promotional ~1 CNY/1M in, ~4 CNY/1M out (~$0.14/$0.56)
standout: 280B sparse MoE activating only 14B parameters per token with native 1M context and throughput over 200 tok/s.
tradeoff: Standard API endpoint is text/code focused with limited multimodal input; complex multi-agent reasoning trails dense frontier flagships.
